item.title: D5N • Quinta-feira, 11 de Junho de 2026
item.description: 12 notícias: 1. Iran-US conflict escalates: Tehran targets US Gulf bases, declares Strait of Hormuz closed. 2. Trump reacts to US inflation topping 4% with provocative tweet "I love inflation". 3. FISA surveillance law may expire after Trump picks Bill Pulte for intel post
